coverage_questions: The atlas seed reports nine configurations and ten routes for scMIR, but the paper does not enumerate those configuration/route identities. The trajectories therefore cover the documented pretraining alignment, image reconstruction, classification, clustering, drug-perturbation morphology inference, HPA morphology inference, and batch-correction paths.
The paper does not specify the tokenizer vocabulary, segmentation algorithm for structured captions, or the exact text-encoder receipt used to produce the text embedding.
The Q-Former attention schedule, masking ratio, attention masks beyond the stated objective-level descriptions, and parameter-sharing implementation are incompletely specified.

The paper does not provide a catalog operation for Cellpose spatial segmentation and cropping, mean aggregation, random token masking, KMeans clustering, or UMAP projection; these remain opaque boundaries or are listed as operation proposals.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Cellpose delineates cell boundaries and crops spatial regions from full-field microscopy images. Selection and partition can express retained positions or channels, while neither represents documented spatial segmentation followed by cropping.
The paper applies a binary random mask and forms masked visual features by element-wise masking. The catalog has no operation for mask application or zeroing selected token positions.

The paper explicitly averages query embeddings, cells, images, wells, treatments, or channels. Concatenation preserves separate contributions and the other compared operations do not represent arithmetic mean pooling.
KMeans clustering and UMAP dimensionality reduction have computation and output semantics absent from the catalog primitives.

evidence.quote: During pre-training, scMIR is trained on paired single-cell images and structured textual captions to enable text-guided visual representation learning.

scMIR integrates complementary learning objectives to capture both semantic and morphological  information. A  vision-language  alignment  module  associates  images with structured textual descriptions to enable cross-dataset semantic consistency, while an  image  reconstruction  module  preserves  fine-grained  morphological  features  to stabilize representation learning
The  image-text  alignment  objective  supervises  the  Q-Former  to  produce  visual embeddings that are semantically consistent with corresponding textual descriptions.
